desc: Implement prefix sum array P of length n+1 and a sparse table supporting range-min and range-max queries on P.
For each distinct value v, collect sorted indices where nums[i] == v; iterate gaps between consecutive occurrences (including ends).
Fix candidate computation: combine gaps per value with Kadane-like scan over gap stats (S, MP, MS, MM) instead of taking max over individual gaps, since segments concatenate after deletion.
Compute the no-operation answer and include it in the maximum.
Verify final solution against both examples and edge cases (single element, all same value, all negative).
